<thought>From the 13C NMR data, only one signal falls in the typical methyl carbon region (~10‑30 ppm): 26.40 ppm. The other upfield signals (36.40 ppm) are higher than usual for methyl carbons and likely correspond to other carbon types. Therefore the molecule contains a single methyl (CH₃) group.</thought>
